tier_a.title: Language Models Need Sleep
tier_a.hook: Sleep-like consolidation converts transformer KV-cache context into persistent SSM fast weights via learned local update rules. Largest gains on deep reasoning.

tier_b.title: GRAIL: Gradient-Reweighted Advantages for RL with Verifiable Rewards
tier_b.hook: Token-wise gradient-activation saliency reweighting for RLVR. +3.60% accuracy over GRPO, no process reward model needed.

tier_b.title: Agentic Transformers Provably Learn to Search via RL
tier_b.hook: Formal proof that RL-trained transformers acquire DFS via a two-head mechanism (trajectory tracking + failure detection). Depth generalization from shallow training.

tier_b.title: Biosignal Fingerprinting: A Cross-Modal PPG-ECG Foundation Model
tier_b.hook: Multi-modal Masked Autoencoder on 3.4M paired ECG/PPG segments. AUROC 0.974 for 5-class CVD. Works with single modality at inference.

tier_c.title: CART: Context-Anchored Recurrent Transformer
tier_c.hook: Parameter-efficient looped transformer with learned LTI stability gate.

tier_c.title: Harness-1: RL for Search Agents
tier_c.hook: 0.730 average recall across 8 retrieval benchmarks via RL over explicit search state.

tier_c.title: Deep Research as Rubric for RL
tier_c.hook: DR-Rubric uses deep research output as RL reward signal, strong with only 1K-3K examples.

tier_c.title: DistIL: RL from Rich Feedback
tier_c.hook: Distributional DAgger improves over GRPO on math, coding, science reasoning.

tier_c.title: MemoGen: Agentic T2I Evolution
tier_c.hook: Training-free layer augments image generators with agentic memory of past generations.

tier_c.title: 3D-Aware Video Diffusion
tier_c.hook: Render-free human motion control via mesh tokenization in video diffusion.

tier_c.title: SCM: Sleep-Consolidated Memory
tier_c.hook: NREM/REM-inspired memory with importance tagging and intentional forgetting for LLMs.

unported.technique: Gradient-activation saliency for token-level credit assignment
unported.hypothesis: Apply per-token gradient saliency reweighting to time-series fine-tuning, where different time steps contribute unequally to downstream clinical predictions.
